pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal pretreatment at 120 °C and 2 atm for 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 60, and 70 minutes. The autoclave was equipped with a time programming system to control the pretreatment time. Each bottle was fed with 15 g of PP or EP substrate.

Aerobic biodegradability test using a respirometer with a thermostated bath and two 1-L Erlenmeyer flasks. Oxygen concentration was monitored continuously by a data acquisition system. The experiment was performed in duplicate, measuring specific oxygen uptake rate (SOUR) and cumulative oxygen demand for twenty hours (OD_20).

Anaerobic digestion in four 1-L Pyrex complete mixing digesters under mesophilic conditions (37 °C). The digesters were equipped with connections for loading feedstock, ventilating biogas, injecting inert gas to maintain anaerobic conditions, and removing effluent. The experiment was performed over a 60-day period, with a substrate:inoculum ratio of 1:7 (g VS).

Initial inoculation of the digesters with a synthetic solution composed of glucose, sodium acetate, and lactic acid (GAL solution) at concentrations of 50 g/L, 25 g/L, and 21 mL/L, respectively, over a 15-day period. The organic load was gradually increased from 0.50 to 1.00 g VS/L.
Co-digestion of pepper and eggplant residues in varying percentages (0-100%) within the anaerobic digesters, with a constant loading of 1.00 g VS/L.

Monitoring of anaerobic digestion parameters including pH, TS, FS, VS, TOC, N-NH4 +, alkalinity, and volatile acidity. The digesters were magnetically stirred and temperature was maintained by a thermostatic jacket.
Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) analysis of the raw materials and pretreated substrates at 4000 cm^-1 to 4500 cm^-1 to evaluate structural changes.
